stories.title: Holywell strikes Gold at Wales in Bloom for the first time
stories.summary: Holywell has been awarded Gold in the town category of the Wales in Bloom Awards 2026, which Holywell Town Council says is the first time the town has achieved it. stories.title: Flintshire residents warned over council tax credit scam email
stories.summary: Flintshire residents are being warned about a scam email claiming money has been credited to their council tax account. stories.summary: Update: Traffic Wales has confirmed the road is now clear. stories.title: Helen MacArthur appointed chief fire officer of North Wales Fire and Rescue Service
stories.summary: North Wales Fire and Rescue Service’s next chief fire officer will be a finance and governance specialist who joined the service eight years ago. stories.title: Risso’s dolphin put down in North Wales after public refloated it before medics arrived
stories.summary: A young Risso’s dolphin was put down on a beach at Penmaenmawr after members of the public dragged it back into the sea before marine medics could assess it.
